evaluation.repetitions: Randomized ABBA order, at least5 matched measured windows per retained load after warmup; retain all runs and bootstrap paired request-window differences; restart pairs to expose allocator/tactic drift
evaluation.advance_rule: Shared protocol design choice: >=5% strict SLO-goodput/capacity improvement with paired95%CI lowerbound>0 at matchedcapacitytest; no>2% p95 TTFT/ITL/E2E regression and nocorrectness/quality regression. At arrival-limited1x, compare tails instead: cannot claim5% goodputheadroom whenbaselinealreadyservesallarrivals. Thresholds are proposed, notmeasured.
evaluation.reject_rule: Numerical contract violation, collective mismatch/deadlock, quality outside preregistered tolerance, repeatable SLO regression, or sufficient precision to exclude a5% gain at target loads.
evaluation.inconclusive_rule: Unresolved baseline identity/inclusion, unsupported backend, confidence interval overlaps material gain and zero, changed acceptance/cache/workload, insufficient observation of targeted path, or bottleneck elsewhere.
evaluation.quality: For arithmetic-preserving workspace/scheduling changes require identical operator outputs against unchanged operator on fixedroutes and seeded repeated fullgeneration where deterministic execution permits; otherwise preregister upstream tolerances before seeing results, verify no new nonfinites and paired full1319 GSM8K plus application trace quality. Do not substitute a few prompts for full regression.
